dossiers.claim: The complete AQABAC family means favorable/benefic facies under a common historical sign-part mapping.
dossiers.scope: GDT796 historical Picatrix and Chaldean candidate matrices, Taurus H0/H1, all global direction/offset transforms; target excluded when selecting its prediction.
dossiers.actually_tested_falsifier: Select the transform without AQABAC, then ask whether its three events remain benefic across the candidate phases rather than select the transformation on the target itself.
dossiers.outcome: The tempting target-selected H0 mapping yields Jupiter/Venus/Venus. With AQABAC withheld, H0 instead predicts Moon/Mercury/Venus, and H1 Moon/Venus/Saturn. The precise benefic reading is not selected. General sign-code transfer is additionally low-capacity: after masking, AQABAB is the sole non-target held family.

reopening.criteria_origin: Prospective reviewer synthesis; not an original preregistration gate.
all_of: Any renewed same-meaning test needs an independent sign/phase/transform determination not chosen to make AQABAC benefic.
A broader cross-sign claim additionally needs several independent non-target families bridging train and held signs, with target-masked evaluation and phase rivals retained.
not_sufficient: Counting the historical matrices or alternate readings as additional manuscript observations.
Treating the weak Picatrix architecture texture as a confirmed AQABAC lexeme.

would_more_admitted_pages_help.answer: Potentially for a new independent mapping test, not by merely adding favorable target hits.
would_more_admitted_pages_help.needed_property: New sign-connected non-target families or independently fixed orientation/phase sufficient to test held target status.
would_more_admitted_pages_help.does_not_repair: More AQABAC events used to choose the mapping whose success they then supposedly validate.

scope_applicability.statement: A failed precise historical transform-bound reading; neither all facies interpretations nor open-polarity AQABAC classes are globally rejected.

evidence.quote:
The historically tempting nominal result is real: under Picatrix H0 with no
offset, the three `AQABAC` events fall under Jupiter, Venus and Venus, hence all
three are benefic. But that arrangement is selected by the target itself.
After withholding `AQABAC`, the best H0 transform is direction +1, offset 9;
AQABAC then becomes Moon/Mercury/Venus, or `OTHER:2|BENEFIC:1`. H1 independently
selects offset 11 and yields Moon/Venus/Saturn, one event in each broad status.
The exact fortunate-facies reading therefore fails.

The required leave-one-sign-out makes the limitation even clearer. Depending
on the held sign, only 5/5/3 families connect both training signs, falling to
4/4/2 after the AQABAC mask. Only `AQABAB` and target-diagnostic `AQABAC` are
then observable on the held sign; the sole non-target prediction is therefore
AQABAB once per holdout. The complete 24-row audit is retained, but this is far
too little capacity to declare a sign-general code. Across H0 and H1 only
three of the six Picatrix non-target AQABAB rows include the held status among
their training modes; after excluding one tied training case, only two of five
unambiguous predictions are correct.

evidence.quote:
GDT792's same-page bridges were real string reuses, but they did not establish
reference direction. GDT793 removes every complete `okal*` form and asks
whether the rest of the record still identifies the alleged source owner.

| record → alleged owner | overlap before mask | overlap after mask | owner recovered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| f72 ring E → ring D | `okal`, `okaly` | none | no |
| f82 P1 → lower communal panel | `okal` | none | no |
| f82 P2 → lower communal panel | `okal` | none | no |

The result is 0/3. In other words, all apparent address evidence disappears
when the candidate is forbidden from proving itself. The class/slot model
does not predict such a companion fingerprint and survives this test.

The f82 P1 and P2 occurrences each have one exact local `okal` candidate, but
both point to the same proximity-ambiguous label between a figure and a
vertical form. Two locally unique cases cannot rescue the four-way f72
collision.

The source owner is recovered only if it has a positive score, is the unique
top owner and has a positive margin over the runner-up. Thus the target cannot
recover its alleged source merely by repeating itself.
